SDG 2030: Race to the Goals

Five years. Seventeen goals. One fragile planet. Lead a nation through war, warming and temptation — and prove the Global Goals can still be won.

🏛️ Govern 2026 → 2030

10 half-year turns. Spend 3 actions each turn on policies from your desk.

🌱 Invest sustainably

Green policies cost more now but compound for years, and goals boost each other.

⚡ Beware quick wins

Oil, arms, austerity and repression pay instantly — then send the bill: disasters, wars, unrest, sanctions.

🌍 The world is watching

Three rival nations follow your lead. Cooperate to keep the planet below 1.5°C.
